# Error Handling in Gateway Function

The `_gateway` function attempts to derive the owner and repo from a specified `forge_ref`, throwing a `CompileError` if it cannot. This handling may not cover all erroneous inputs cleanly, possibly leading to unhandled errors in edge cases.

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli._gateway`
